concept.title: Egypt, *for sports founders.*
concept.subtitle: A Sporting Founders cohort meet-up in Egypt: three settings, with NOYA running the ground and the community keeping the programme.
concept.lead: Sporting Founders brings sports entrepreneurs together across more than forty countries. One in-person meet-up gives a cohort what a call cannot. NOYA runs the place, the stays and the movement; Sporting Founders keeps the programme and the people.

why.label: The community
why.text: A first cohort spread across 43 countries: Egypt sits within easy reach of Europe, Africa and the Gulf.

options.title: The Cairo meet-up
options.text: Two days in Cairo: sessions and pitches by day, an evening facing the Pyramids, the Grand Egyptian Museum before flights.

options.title: The Red Sea performance retreat
options.text: Three days in El Gouna: training and recovery by the sea in the morning, sessions in the afternoon.

options.title: The founders' Nile journey
options.text: A small group of founders between Luxor and Aswan: a private Nile journey and time to think.
